red_convert_stonyhurst.pro


Routines

top source red_convert_stonyhurst

SST pipeline

result = red_convert_stonyhurst(stonyhurst_coordinates, isodate, time [, helio=fltarr(2,n)])

Convert Stonyhurst coordinates to Cartesian Helioprojective coordinates.

Return value

Parameters

stonyhurst_coordinates in type=fltarr(2,n) or strarr(n)

Stonyhurst latitude and longitude, N pairs of coordinates to be converted to HPLN,HPLT coordinates. If strings, then on the form "N 2.02 W 0.16", where the spaces are optional and N could be S and W could be E. Stonyhurst coordinates are in degrees.

isodate in type=string

The date in ISO format.

time in type=double

The time in seconds after midnight.

Keywords

helio out optional type=fltarr(2,n)

The input Stonyhurst coordinates as numbers, in arcsec. Helio[0,*] = E/W = longitude; helio[1,*] = N/S = latitude.
